name: Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11
description: The ultimate business laptop with Intel vPro, legendary ThinkPad reliability, and ultralight design.
longDescription: The ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11 represents the pinnacle of business computing. Weighing just 2.48 lbs, this ultralight powerhouse features Intel vPro platform for enterprise security, a stunning 14-inch 2.8K OLED display, and up to 15 hours of battery life. The legendary ThinkPad keyboard and TrackPoint ensure productive work anywhere.
